display_name: Pillar-0 Qwen findings-style task-specific prompts v1

method_source.paper: Pillar-0: A Strong Multimodal Foundation Model for Abdomen CT
method_source.method: Exploratory cosine similarity between Pillar image embeddings and findings-style Qwen embeddings passed through the matching trained Pillar text projection.

capability_contract.required_checkpoint_capability: The downloaded Pillar checkpoint must expose the trained text projection that maps 4096-dimensional Qwen embeddings into the same 1152-dimensional space as its image projection.
capability_contract.forbidden_fallback: Do not compare raw Qwen embeddings directly with Pillar image features, do not insert a random projection, and do not report zero-shot metrics if the compatible trained text projection is unavailable.
capability_contract.resource_note: Encode and cache the small fixed prompt bank first, release Qwen3-Embedding-8B, then load the 3-D vision encoder to fit a 24 GB GPU.

text_embedding.provenance: Mirrors CachedTextEmbedding in the pinned official pillar-pretrain repository.

scoring.embedding_normalization: L2 per image and per projected prompt
scoring.prompt_aggregation: mean of individual prompt cosine similarities
scoring.five_class_rule: argmax of the mean positive-prompt cosine similarity
scoring.author_binary_rule: positive when mean positive-prompt cosine similarity exceeds mean negative-prompt cosine similarity

prompt_provenance.selection: Prompts are fixed and versioned before any held-out evaluation.
prompt_provenance.note: The Pillar-0 study does not demonstrate or release a zero-shot classifier for these five labels. The semantic aliases follow the established repository task interpretation, while wording is adapted to radiology findings text because Pillar-0 aligned CT volumes with report Findings sections.

class_assumptions.Cholezystitis: Dataset spelling is retained in outputs; prompt text uses the standard clinical spelling cholecystitis.
class_assumptions.Perforation: Interpreted as gastrointestinal or hollow-viscus perforation.

class_semantics_status: Implementation assumptions approved for this workflow but not independently verified from original dataset provenance; zero-shot results remain exploratory until clinical review.

positive: Findings demonstrate a dilated inflamed appendix with surrounding inflammatory change, consistent with acute appendicitis.
The appendix is enlarged with periappendiceal fat stranding, compatible with acute appendicitis.
There are CT findings of acute appendicitis in the right lower quadrant.
An acutely inflamed appendix is present.
negative: The appendix is normal without periappendiceal inflammation.
There is no CT evidence of acute appendicitis.
No dilated or inflamed appendix is identified.
Findings are not consistent with acute appendicitis.

negative: The gallbladder is without acute inflammatory change.
There is no CT evidence of acute cholecystitis.
No gallbladder wall thickening or pericholecystic inflammation is identified.
Findings are not consistent with acute cholecystitis.

positive: No acute abnormality is identified in the abdomen or pelvis.
The CT of the abdomen and pelvis is without acute pathology.

negative: An acute abnormality is present in the abdomen or pelvis.
The CT demonstrates acute intra-abdominal pathology.
